entities.summary: Pala, a notable figure in the history of Bangladesh, associated with Gupta and Pala Golden Ages (750–1161). Preceded by Pala Dynasty and Buddhist Civilization and King Shashanka of Gauda emerges as Bengal's first significant independent ruler. Their legacy influenced Sena Dynasty and Hindu Revival and Sena.
